meta.title: dsh-chatterbox
meta.description: 大肥鱼 (Dayufeiyu) — a Japanese voice companion for DeepSeek. Talk with your 大肥鱼 by voice in Chinese, English or Japanese; she always replies in Japanese. Push-to-talk and a hands-free microphone, and it keeps answering in the background. For first-time setup, ask an AI to read docs\INSTALL.zh.md in the plugin folder.
